requirement: The estimator shall expose the interface X = kalman_update(Z, model) exactly.
The estimator shall return an N-by-4 matrix of posterior estimates, one row per input measurement, in input order.
The estimator shall implement the predict/update recursion of §4 using the model constants, initializing state and covariance from model.x0 and model.P0.
The estimator shall be deterministic: identical (Z, model) yields identical X.
The implementation shall be accompanied by a runnable test exercising R1-R4.
Non-finite or malformed measurements shall be rejected and reported, never propagated into the state.
The gate shall compute d2 by solving S x = y (not by forming inv(S)).
The gate shall admit a measurement if and only if d2 <= gamma.
The gate shall use the supplied gamma (the chi-squared critical value for the configured confidence and the active mode's measurement dimension) and hold no threshold of its own.
The gate shall fail closed on non-finite y or S and on a non-finite or non-positive gamma, without raising an error.
The gate shall be accompanied by a runnable test that exercises G1-G4.
